correctness.rationale: The eight trilinear NDB basis checks for [t,x]=x reduce to b+c=0 and 2d=0, so for char(k)!=2 the nondegenerate matrix is [[a,b],[-b,0]], b!=0. Lie automorphisms t->t+beta x, x->lambda x preserve a and multiply b by lambda. Pairing the induced product against t,x gives t*t=-t-(a/b)x, t*x=0, x*t=-x, x*x=0; its commutator recovers [t,x]=x and its left-multiplication commutator satisfies the pre-Lie identity. A product isomorphism requires s=r lambda, so exactly the zero and nonzero parameter classes; the nonzero-idempotent locus distinguishes them. Independent GF(3) form enumeration yielded precisely six matrices (3 choices of a and 2 nonzero b), checking a non-real boundary; the algebraic proof, not the finite census, establishes all fields char!=2.
